title: Revisão 5 · Experiências e Duração: Have Been, For & Since

vocab.ex: I have been to London three times.
We have lived here for three years.
I haven't finished the report yet.
We have just arrived at the hotel.
Have you ever tried Thai food?
I have never missed a flight.
We have visited four cities so far.
Have you spoken to Lucas recently?

expressions.example: We have lived here for three years, since 2021.
I haven't finished the report yet.
She has already sent the email.

expressions.expr: I have been to... / My last trip was in...
expressions.meaning: Já fui a... / Minha última viagem foi em...
expressions.example: I have been to London three times, and my last trip was in 2022.

sentences: I have been to London three times in my life, and my last trip was in 2022.
We have lived in this apartment for three years, since we got married in 2021.
I haven't finished the report yet, but Maria has already sent hers.
She has worked at this hospital for five years, since she graduated.
Have you ever spoken English in a job interview?
Look at all the progress you have made so far!

grammar.title: Experiências de Vida, FOR vs. SINCE e Already / Yet
rules: Experiências de vida sem data fechada usam HAVE / HAS + 3ª forma: "I have been to London three times".
Se dissermos QUANDO aconteceu ("in 2022", "last year"), voltamos para o passado simples: "My last trip was in 2022".
FOR mostra o tempo de duração (for three years); SINCE mostra o ponto exato de início (since 2021 / since Monday).
ALREADY indica que já aconteceu (has already sent); YET no final indica "ainda não" (haven't finished yet).
